description: Replace broken podman-based test database with embedded-postgres for integration and E2E tests. Update scripts, justfile, and steering docs.
steps: Install embedded-postgres as devDependency and approve build scripts
Create scripts/test-db.ts shared module exporting startTestDatabase/stopTestDatabase helpers
Rewrite scripts/test-integration.mjs to use embedded-postgres (auto-manage DB) or honor TEST_DATABASE_URL if provided
Rewrite e2e/global-setup.ts to start embedded-postgres, run migrations, seed auth
Rewrite e2e/global-teardown.ts to cleanup and stop embedded-postgres
Update playwright.config.ts webServer env to use embedded-postgres URL
Update justfile recipes for test-integration-local and e2e-local to work without containers
Update scripts/start-test-db.sh to document embedded-postgres as primary method
Verify: format, lint, typecheck, unit tests, integration tests, build
acceptance_criteria: corepack pnpm test:integration runs successfully without external database
Integration tests hit a real embedded PostgreSQL through the full action->service->repository->DB path
E2E global setup starts embedded-postgres and seeds auth data
justfile recipes work without manual container setup
All existing unit tests still pass
